question: What is a feature of an electronic programmable logic device (EPLD) upgrade on a Cisco MDS 9000 Series Switch?
options: Only the modules that are being upgraded are disrupted.
An EPLD upgrade is disruptive on all modules.
The standby supervisor module can perform the upgrade.
An EPLD upgrade is nondisruptive on all modules.
theory: An EPLD upgrade on any Cisco MDS module always reloads that specific module to apply the new hardware logic, but this impact is isolated to the module being upgraded - every other online module, and the switch's overall forwarding for unaffected ports, continues to operate normally, which is why EPLD maintenance can typically be scheduled module-by-module without a full outage. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 11 - EPLD Upgrade)
